svg.title: Remote workplace (v1.3, after Curator CIP-0009 revision 2): a remote worker turn: the harness has no local tools; the relay (harness identity) forwards to the bridge service (bridge identity), which carries every tool call and the mailbox over ONE SSH connection from the donor to our host; our host never connects back

g.text: Remote workplace (v1.3, after Curator CIP-0009 revision 2): a remote worker turn: the harness has no local tools; the relay (harness identity) forwards to the bridge service (bridge identity), which carries every tool call and the mailbox over ONE SSH connection from the donor to our host; our host never connects back
Donor machine: harness identity (sandboxed, egress = proxy only)
Donor machine: bridge identity (keys, audit, cursors)
ssh workplace-user@host with K_ssh; host key checked against the pin on EVERY connection (no TOFU)
hello {versions:[1]} / swarma-rb/1 channel open (bounded CBOR frames, flow credits)
workplace policy {tools, write scope, network, limits, env_allow} -> effective tool set
Match block: root-owned AuthorizedKeysFile, restrict, no forwarding, no PTY,
no user rc/env; forced command by absolute path; reconnect is the donor side's job
obtain the composed plan from the construction site (agents-management);
check expect_pin, tool_posture=lockdown, permissions=remote-auto, policy generation, qualified tuple;
validate the expanded launch against the generated policy; resolve credential_binding/1
start as the harness identity under the Seatbelt profile
token in the harness environment only, CIP-0010)
MCP initialize; tools/list = effective set (policy intersection)
signed task message to the worker (snapshot of one element)
verify signature, grant, decision guard, fence; mailbox record; cursor++
DONOR-SIDE ADMISSION: verification record present, target binding = this worker,
unexpired, not fenced/revoked, delivery mode allowed; dedup by message_id; persist; cursor++
next turn through the session-input adapter: "validated message <id>" + snapshot
mailbox.applied {message_id} (application receipt, distinct from the transport reply)
forward over the relay socket (peer credentials checked)
audit line {tool, args_sha256, bytes, at}; budget counters (trusted side)
frame exec {id, op_key, cmd, cwd, env (env_allow only), timeout_s <= policy, max_output_bytes <= policy, lease_s}
run as the workplace user in its own process group with a lease; audit {who, what, when, policy id}
frames (result cached by op_key for 10 min)
model API calls (the only egress of the harness identity)
[the model requests a built-in tool (Bash, Edit, WebFetch ...)]
harness returns an error tool result (tool not available);
the tripwire logs the name after dispatch and may end the turn
pause the turn loop; running turn continues to its deadline;
tool calls fail with channel_down (retryable); result post queued durably with its op_key
reconnect with backoff; host key rechecked; catch up from the durable cursor;
replay-safe: cached result or unknown_result, never a second effect
tools/call mailbox_post {binding, text} (offered only when the policy grants it)
build the FINAL envelope (canonical bytes; audience/thread from the task record);
sign with K_sig (never leaves the bridge identity)
verify K_sig signature, grant, freshness; admit
carry the bytes UNCHANGED under the worker's carrier account (distinct authority, audited) -> outcome proposal
